description: Frees the database of an idle app without losing anything: the app stays listed and reachable and is restored by itself on the next open. Owner only. Refused (skipped) when someone is in it now, when it or its players have an active subscription, or when already archived.

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.
